definition: an insulting remark; an attack with insulting language.
example: ಆ ಕೆಕ್ಕಸ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮುಖ ಕೆಂಪಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that insulting remark, his face turned red.

definition: a luminous arc showing the prismatic colours, appearing opposite the sun during rain, caused by the reflection, double refraction and dispersion of the sun's rays passing through the drops; a rainbow.
example: ಮಳೆ ನಿಂತ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂದ್ರಚಾಪ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After the rain stopped, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

definition: (dial.) a kind of poison.
example: ಆ ಗಿಡದ ಬೇರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡು ಅಡಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say that poison is hidden in the root of that plant.

definition: the act of excusing or forgiving an offence, error, etc. an inclination or tendency to do so.
example_en: The teacher granted forgiveness for the disciple's mistake.

definition: a kind of zedoary plant of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: The doctor recommended the doddakhacora root for medicine.

definition: a harsh or sarcastic remark; a scornful taunt causing pain in another's mind.
example_en: Her sarcastic remark caused pain to his mind.

definition: to become demolished, destroyed completely.
example_en: The old house was completely destroyed by the earthquake.

definition: the act of closing and opening of the eyelids.
example_en: When sleep came, his blinking (eyelid movement) slowed down.

definition: a kind of fish; (= black geṇḍe mīnu?).
example_en: The kagende fish is found in the lake.

definition: a single blood vessel.
example: ಗಾಯದಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಒಚ್ಚೆರೆ ಹರಿದು ರಕ್ತ ಸೋರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A single blood vessel was torn from the wound and blood was oozing.

definition: lower ground; land at the foothill.
example_en: That village is situated on the lower ground at the foothill.

definition: a careful search or examination to find the reason, fact, etc.; an investigation.
example: ಪೋಲೀಸರು ಈ ಘಟನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಹಕೀತು ನಡೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: The police conducted an investigation into this incident.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example_en: The temple's dome was gleaming in the sunlight.

definition: amounting to seventy.
example_en: That old man is now seventy years old.

definition: a depressed part or place; a hollow; a depression.
example_en: Rainwater collected in the hollow of the ground.

definition: the large, deciduous tree Stephegyne parviflora (= Mitragyna parviflora) of Rubiaceae family.
example_en: Kalam trees had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: a gay, light-hearted action or mood; fun; joking.
example_en: His speech is always full of fun and light-heartedness.

definition: all over; widely; spreading over a wide area.
example_en: The fire spread widely all over.

definition: a kind of typhs disease, accompanied by high fever in which the patient keeps uttering insensible or nonsensical words continuously; typhomania.
example_en: He got typhomania due to high fever.

definition: childish, immature talk.
example: ಅವನ ಬಾಲೋತ್ತರ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one took his childish, immature talk seriously.

definition: a strong, courageos man.
example_en: In that village there was a young man known as a strong, courageous fellow.

definition: an act or instance of kissing.
example_en: The mother gave a kiss on the child's forehead.

definition: floating; swimming over.
example_en: That boat was floating on the water.

definition: a group associated for some purpose, as to form a commercial or industrial firm.
example: ಈ ಕಂಪನಿ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ನೀಡಿದೆ.
example_en: This company has given employment to thousands of people.

definition: to become cold or colder.
example_en: The atmosphere quickly becomes cold in the rainy season.

definition: to neglect - a) to ignore or disregard; b) to fail to care for or attend to sufficiently or properly; to slight.
example: ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ತನ್ನ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅವಗಡಿಸಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಒಳಗಾದನು.
example_en: The officer was punished for neglecting his duty.

definition: to make threats against; express one's intention of hurting, punishing, etc.; to threaten.
example_en: The goon threatened the shopkeeper for money.

definition: a man believed to know the events happened in the past, happening at present, and will happen in future.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲವೇದಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಮುಂದಿನದನ್ನೂ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: That knower of time accurately told both past events and future ones.

definition: accord; consonance; agreement.
example_en: There was good accord between the two opinions.

definition: to take or seize by force; to capture.
example_en: The soldiers seized that fort by force.

definition: to send a message or messages through a courier, runner or mesenger.
example_en: The king sent a message to the army through a courier.

definition: a beloved husband.
example_en: Her beloved husband had gone to war.

definition: with no name; being anonymous.
example_en: That letter was anonymous.

definition: an ornament.
example: ರಾಣಿ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಲೆಬಾಳುವ ವತಂಸ ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The queen wore a precious ornament on her head.

definition: a strong, thick cord, made of twisted or braided strands of hemp, flax, coir or the like; a rope.
example_en: A rope is needed to draw water from the well.

definition: a secret, usu. evil, project or scheme; conspiracy; a plot.
example_en: They hatched a conspiracy against the king.

definition: to beat with a stick, club repeatedly.
example: ಆ ಕುರುಬ ಹಟಮಾರಿ ಎತ್ತನ್ನು ಕೋಲಿನಿಂದ ಸೆಣೆದನು.
example_en: That shepherd beat the stubborn ox repeatedly with a stick.

definition: the back of the neck; the nape; the nucha.
example_en: She placed her hand on the nape of her neck.

definition: the frame of a door.
example_en: The carpenter fixed the door-frame to the door.

definition: one who makes hostile inroad into or oppressively attacks; an invader.
example_en: Invaders attacked near the border.

definition: to jump from above to a lower place.
example_en: He jumped down from the high rock.

definition: the citrus tree Citrus aurantium (var. bigardia) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: There are orange trees in the garden.

definition: an expression of rebuke or disapproval.
example_en: Hearing the teacher's rebuke, the disciple bowed his head.

definition: the evening sun about to set.
example_en: The setting evening sun was going down behind the hill.

definition: an occurrence that happens everyday.
example_en: Going for a walk in the morning was his everyday routine.

definition: a mountain.
example_en: That mountain was covered with clouds.

definition: a making a heap of harvested crop.
example_en: They made a heap of the harvested paddy in the field.

definition: to jump or move in the air obliquely.
example: ಮಗು ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಱುವಾಱಿ ನಗುತ್ತಾ ಆಡಿತು.
example_en: The child jumped obliquely on the grass and played laughing.

definition: a transporting or being transported; transportation; conveyance.
example: ಸರಕುಗಳ ಸಾಗಣೆ ಈಗ ಟ್ರಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The transportation of goods now happens by trucks.

definition: a fall of rain with splashes; a splashing of rain.
example: ಆ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಇಱಿಸಿಲ್ ಕಿಟಕಿ ಬಾಗಿಲನ್ನು ಒದ್ದೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That night's splashing rain wetted the window and door.

definition: the act, practice or quality of being hospitable; solicitous entertainment of guests.
example_en: That house's hospitality is very famous.

definition: an arrow with a crescent-head.
example_en: The hunter kept the crescent-headed arrow in his quiver.

definition: ground, crushed with the teeth.
example_en: Food must be chewed well until it is ground with the teeth.

definition: the act of discriminating between two classes of a society.
example_en: Class discrimination causes problems in society.

definition: a person belonging to, coming from or native of to China.
example_en: The shop owner is a Chinese person.

definition: the security of a country or state.
example_en: The army worked hard to strengthen the security of the country.

definition: a bracelet, ring, armlet (worn by men and women).
example_en: There was a silver bracelet on his hand.

definition: (a young shoot) to be put forth.
example_en: In the rainy season, a young shoot put forth on the creeper.

definition: to become extinct; to wane; to become ruined completely.
example_en: The old business gradually became extinct.

definition: to make or shape by or as by cutting, chipping, hewing, etc. with a chisel; to carve; to sculpt.
example: ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಕಲ್ವಟ್ಟು ದೇವರ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The sculptor carved the stone to make the idol of the god.

definition: a young of a cobra.
example_en: A young cobra was crawling amid the grass.

definition: a vomiting of blood.
example_en: Due to the severity of the injury, he had a vomiting of blood.

definition: the fact of conforming to the times.
example_en: The youth adopted new practices in conformity with the times.

definition: the state of being without clothing or covering (on the body); nakedness.
example_en: The child ran about in nakedness without shame.

definition: any of a group of synthetic long-chain polymeric amides with recurring amide groups, made into fibre, yarn, bristles, sheets, moulded plastics, etc. known for their great strength and elasticity; nylon.
example_en: That cloth was made from nylon.

definition: a bringing into action or carrying into effect; implementation.
example: ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಜಾರಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ತಿಂಗಳಿಂದ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The implementation of the new scheme happens from next month.

definition: a form of address to a man; 'misteṛ, 'Mr.'.
example: ಜನರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಮೆಸ್ತರ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: People respectfully called him 'Mister'.

definition: a man who has stored food-supplies that would last for three days.
example_en: As a man with three days' food stored, he spent the rainy season in comfort.

definition: the back part of the human foot, under the ankle and behind the instep; the heel.
example_en: Hitting a stone, her heel began to bleed.

definition: a period in human culture during which stone implements are used; the stone age.
example_en: People of the Stone Age used stone implements.

definition: one who fights; a warrior; a soldier.
example_en: The warrior stood without fear before the enemy army.

definition: respectability in the society; renown; fame.
example_en: His renown had spread throughout the town.

definition: to cause to pierce into.
example_en: He drove the nail into the wood.

definition: a series of lightnings.
example_en: A series of lightnings appeared in the sky.

definition: to determine; to decide.
example_en: He decided to travel.

definition: defying or resisting some established authority, government or tradition; insubordinate; inclined to rebel; rebellious.
example_en: That group became known for its rebellious activities.

definition: the satellite of the earth; the moon.
example_en: The moon was shining in the sky.

definition: any one of a series of moments at which the same or nearly the same thing recurs; time.
example_en: This time the rain came early.

definition: a message or communication sent by telegraph; a telegraphic message.
example_en: He sent a telegram to the office.

definition: a going around begging for money, grains, etc.
example_en: The monk lived by going around the villages begging for alms.

definition: to suffer the loss of; to be deprived of; to lose.
example_en: He lost all his property in gambling.

definition: a kind of fire works, that burns with bright light, when lit.
example_en: The children watched the firework burning with curiosity.

definition: to push forward oneself against the stroke of a weapon.
example_en: The warrior pushed himself forward against the enemy's weapon.

definition: thick; fat; corpulent; plump.
example_en: The buffalo appeared fat and stout.

definition: a bad symbol or a symbol indicating something bad, wicked or evil.
example: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ ಆ ಕನಸನ್ನು ದುರ್ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The astrologer said that dream was a bad omen.

definition: an iron hook for lifting heavy weights; a crampon.
example_en: The workers lifted the heavy stone with an iron hook.

definition: the outer protective covering of a book.
example_en: The book's protective cover is torn.

definition: the route for air traffic; airway; airline.
example_en: The aircraft was travelling along the airway.

definition: (pl.) two sides; both the sides; the extent on either sides.
example_en: They planted trees on both sides of the road.

definition: an animal used for pulling heavy loads; a draft animal.
example_en: The farmer yoked the draft animal to the cart.

definition: unpolluted, unselfish devotion.
example: ಅವನ ಸದುಭಕ್ತಿ ದೇವರ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಸ್ವಾರ್ಥ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His pure devotion showed unselfish love for God.

definition: a term used in playing games to indicate 'stop', 'oveṛ, 'okay', etc.
example_en: All the players shouted 'stop' and halted the game.

definition: the tree Spondias pinnata ( = S. mangifera) of anacardiaceae family.
example_en: The pindi tree in the forest was full of fruits.

definition: a medicine (usu. in powder form) that increases digestion power.
example_en: The doctor gave a digestion-stimulating powder for the digestive power.

definition: the act of going, travelling.
example_en: His journey extended a great distance.

definition: a proposal, suggestion formally made in an assembly or meeting to cut down the official expenditure on a particular account; a cut-motion.
example_en: The legislator moved a cut-motion in the assembly.

definition: to bend one's body in obeisance.
example_en: The disciple bowed his body before the guru.

definition: the state of being not aware of the surroundings.
example: ಪೆಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಣ ಮಱವು ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The blow made him momentarily unaware of his surroundings.

definition: totalling four-hundred.
example_en: There were four hundred soldiers in the army.

definition: (a plant) to put forth new leaf or leaves; (a seed) to put forth the new growth; to shoot; to sprout.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮರದ ಟೊಂಗೆಗಳು ಚಿಗುರಿದವು.
example_en: After the rain, the tree's branches put forth new shoots.

definition: the state of being half-ground (as grains).
example_en: Do not use the half-ground millet for flour.

definition: (fibres, strads, etc.) to be intertwisted and become a strong cord.
example_en: The strands twisted together and became a strong rope.

definition: the act or state of fulfilling; fulfilment; success.
example_en: His efforts finally attained success.

definition: a building for the worship of a divinity or divinities; a temple.
example_en: There is an ancient temple in the middle of the town.

definition: to step back; to go back; to return.
example_en: The frightened soldier stepped back.

definition: a peacock (that has a tuft of feathers on the head).
example: ಶಿಖಾವಲವು ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಗರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಚ್ಚಿತು.
example_en: The crested peacock sat on the tree and spread its feathers.

definition: to becomd oblique or slant.
example_en: The picture on the wall had become a little slanted.

definition: a rocky area; a mound; a hillock.
example_en: There was a rocky mound beyond the village.

definition: (a meaningless word used as an adjective to modify) the heat of the rising sun.
example_en: The heat of the morning rising sun felt gently warm.

definition: a pointed leaf or quill.
example_en: They used to use the pointed quill for writing.

definition: the sensation resulting from stimulation of the retina of the eye by light waves of certain lengths; colour.
example_en: There are seven colours in the rainbow.

definition: a man who enjoys the benefit from or the possession of (a property etc.); an occupier.
example: ಜಮೀನಿನ ಅನುಭೋಗದಾರ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The occupier of the land was harvesting crops every year.

definition: a multitude of servants.
example_en: A multitude of servants had crowded at the fair.

definition: a feeling of high regard, honour or esteem; respect.
example_en: Showing respect to elders is our culture.

definition: to discharge an arrow; to shoot an arrow.
example_en: The hunter shot an arrow at the deer.

definition: a man imprisoned; a prisoner.
example_en: That thief was imprisoned as a prisoner in jail.

definition: the quality or fact of lacking spirit, vitality etc.
example: ಆ ಕಥೆಯ ನಿಸ್ಸಾರತೆ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಬೇಸರ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The lack of vitality in that story bored the readers.

definition: fortune of getting an offspring.
example_en: That couple finally had the fortune of getting an offspring.

definition: a good sight, view.
example_en: The fine view of the sunset from the hilltop was good.

definition: honoured, respected by a king.
example_en: That poet was a scholar honoured by the king.

definition: a mace-like war weapon having barbed head.
example_en: The warrior set out for battle carrying the barbed mace.

definition: any soluble substance, as a mineral salt or mixture of salts, that can neutralize acids, has a pH more than 7.0, and turns litmus blue: an alkali.
example_en: The alkali neutralized the acid in the laboratory.

definition: being under another's arbitrary control; not free; divested of all freedom.
example_en: That servant lived under the control of his master, not free.

definition: a woman whose body is beautiful.
example_en: She, a woman of beautiful body, attracted the king's heart.

definition: a kind of war weapon.
example_en: In the old war, soldiers used to use the sūgali weapon.

definition: a kind of physical combat in which both contestants collide each other head on.
example_en: A head-on collision combat took place between the two bulls.

definition: to be or fit to be eaten; edible.
example_en: That fruit is edible.

definition: to enforce customs, esp. religious ones.
example_en: The priests enforced the religious customs of the worship.

definition: a pouring out.
example_en: At the end of the worship, a pouring out of water was performed.

definition: situated outside one's own country; foreign.
example_en: This cloth is of foreign origin.

definition: (smoke) to be emitted.
example_en: Thick smoke was being emitted from the stove.

definition: a man who can recognise, appreciate others merit or has the discriminatory knowledge in the field of quality.
example_en: That discerning man can recognise everyone's merit.

definition: a philosophic system denying the existence of god and holding beliefs that are contrary to vedas.
example: ಆ ಗುಂಪು ಪಾಷಂಡ ಎಂದು ಸಮಾಜ ಖಂಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The society condemned that group as a heretical sect.

definition: amounting to fifty in number; fifty.
example_en: There were fifty rupee notes in that bag.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example_en: The form 'pokkału' meaning navel appears in the inscription.

definition: he who is disinclined to labour or exertion; a lazy, idle man; an indolent.
example_en: That lazy, indolent man refused to work.

definition: a dream or dreams that is pleasing.
example_en: The child lay sleeping with a pleasant dream.

definition: wages, salary or any other recompense earned by working; earnings.
example: ಈ ತಿಂಗಳ ಸಂಪಾದನದಿಂದ ಅವನು ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: With this month's earnings, he repaid the loan.

definition: a board or small platform for supporting the feet, for standing on or entering in (to a vehicle etc.); a footboard.
example: ಬಸ್ ಹತ್ತುವ ಮೊದಲು ಕಾಲುಫಳಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲಿಟ್ಟು ಏರಿದನು.
example_en: Before boarding the bus, he stepped on the footboard and climbed up.

definition: a starting or commencing; a beginning.
example_en: The beginning of the rainy season happens in June.

definition: one of the three types or schools of sculpture of India.
example_en: Temples of the vēsara style of architecture are found in Karnataka.

definition: the front portion of a foot.
example_en: The sandal was torn near the front portion of the foot.

definition: to go past by; to overtake.
example_en: The vehicle overtook the slow cart.

definition: a shop, place where toddy, liquors, etc. are sold.
example_en: They have opened a liquor shop outside the village.

definition: the influence natural or normal to a particular time, period or age.
example_en: This is a change that occurred due to the influence of the times.

definition: a soldier who vanquishes distinguished heroes.
example: ಅದಟಕಾಳಾನಲ ಎಂಬ ಸೈನಿಕ ಶತ್ರು ವೀರರನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The soldier called adaṭakāḷānala vanquished the enemy's distinguished heroes.

definition: a man who has risen up against the government or any authority; one who engages in such a movement; a rebel.
example: ಆ ದಂಗೆಗಾರ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಜನರನ್ನು ಸಂಘಟಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That rebel organised the people against the army.

definition: an act or instance of lifting up (with a support from below).
example: ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಕಂಬಗಳ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಚಾವಣಿಯ ನೆಗೆಹ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The workers lifted up the roof with the support of poles.

definition: to come or rush out suddenly, issue, esp. in a jet or stream; (of water etc.) rise or flow in a stream, well up; to spring up, forth or out.
example_en: Water gushed out from the crevice of the rock and flowed.

definition: utterance of hymns (repeatedly).
example_en: The priest performed the repeated chanting of hymns in the temple.

definition: to long for; to be keenly desirous of; to be or become anxious.
example_en: The grandmother longed keenly to see the child.

definition: a kind of medicinal herb.
example_en: They collected hālangoḷale for medicine.

definition: a man who is close by or living near (one's place).
example_en: The neighbour came and introduced himself.

definition: a loose fold of skin hanging from the throat of cattle and certain other animals; the dewlap.
example_en: The cow's dewlap swayed as it walked.

definition: the name of a country to the north of India; China.
example_en: China is the largest country in the world by population.

definition: the sound of bellowing (as of a bull, bison, pig, etc.).
example_en: Hearing the bellowing of the pig, everyone got scared.

definition: a slave of a slave or a servant of a servant.
example: ಆ ಪಡಿದಂಡಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That servant of a servant was working in a big house.

definition: the second of the two halves; the latter half.
example_en: The rain decreased in the latter half of the year.

definition: the repairing and maintenance of buildings, roads, water-tanks, etc.
example: ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಮರಾಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಂದಿನ ವಾರ ಶುರುವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The road repair work begins next week.

definition: the doing of something; an action.
example_en: His action brought a good result.

definition: the great body of salt water; the ocean.
example_en: The waves of the ocean dashed against the shore.

definition: a plant of Solanaceae family.
example_en: A Solanaceae plant has grown in the corner of the garden.

definition: an active man.

example: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಸಂತೋಷಗಳ ಬೋಗವೇ ನಿಜವಾದ ಸುಖ.
example_en: The enjoyment of small joys in life is true happiness.

definition: the cord of a bow; a bow-string.
example_en: The hunter pulled the bow-string of the bow.

definition: any sound produced from the throat.
example: ಅವನ ಗಳರವ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡಿದರು.
example_en: Hearing the sound from his throat, everyone turned and looked.

definition: the pointed end of a woman's hair.
example_en: The pointed end of her hair hung down over her back.

definition: (grammatically a wrong compound) a large white bear found in the Arctic regions; polar bear.
example_en: The polar bear is found only in the icy regions.

definition: an excellent brāhmaṇa.
example_en: The excellent brahmana was very learned in the scriptures.

definition: a pair of doors.
example_en: There was a pair of doors at the front of the house.

definition: the precious yellow metallic element, highly malleable and ductile, and not subject to oxidation or corrosion (symbol: Au); gold.
example_en: Grandmother was wearing a gold necklace.

definition: a dream - a) a sequence of sensations, images, thoughts, etc. passing through a sleeping person's mind; b) a fanciful vision of the conscious mind; daydream; fantasy; reverie; c) a fond hope or aspiration; d) anything so lovely, charming, transitory, etc. as to seem dreamlike.
example_en: She saw a beautiful dream.

definition: cattle excrement used to fertilise soil; manure.
example_en: They transported the cattle-shed manure to the garden by cart.

definition: Pongo pygmaeus, a large, long-armed anthropoid ape. Orang utang.
example: ಮೃಗಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನರವಾನರವೊಂದು ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಿಗಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: An orangutan was jumping on the tree branches at the zoo.

definition: (pl.) a few people.
example_en: Only a few people had come to the meeting.
